terms.gloss: handle, something to take hold of
terms.comment: Our extension of the classical word for a handle, that by which something is taken hold of (Lewis & Short). Traupman and Morgan–Owens name the climber and the sport (ascēnsor, ascēnsiō, Traupman 48; rūpium ascēnsor, M-O s.v. hike: rock climber) but have no word for an artificial hold.

sources: Lewis & Short: ansa
L&S ansa documents handles and things taken hold of. The hold and route senses above are our semantic extensions.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 48.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. hike: rock climber.
